INT | Local Control Dashboard

PURPOSE
Provides the local browser entry point for the read-only Agent V2 operations dashboard.

CONTROL BOUNDARY
GET only. The Agent V2 n8n port is loopback-bound and the HTTPS ingress does not route this path. No public deployment is authorized by this workflow.

parameters.query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'generated_at', now(),
  'business', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'company_name', company_name,
      'timezone', timezone,
      'currency_code', currency_code,
      'stale_deal_days', stale_deal_days,
      'minimum_pipeline_coverage', minimum_pipeline_coverage
    )
    FROM governance.business_config
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ), '{}'::jsonb),
  'runtime', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'overall_status', overall_status,
      'component_count', component_count,
      'healthy_components', healthy_components,
      'degraded_components', degraded_components,
      'blocked_components', blocked_components,
      'unknown_components', unknown_components,
      'failures_1h', failures_1h,
      'failures_24h', failures_24h,
      'open_dead_letters', open_dead_letters,
      'observed_at', observed_at
    )
    FROM observability.runtime_status
  ), '{}'::jsonb),
  'active_kpi_count', (
    SELECT count(*)
    FROM governance.kpi_catalog
    WHERE active
  ),
  'connectors', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'connector_key', connector_key,
        'connector_type', connector_type,
        'display_name', display_name,
        'active', active,
        'updated_at', updated_at
      )
      ORDER BY connector_key
    )
    FROM governance.connector_registry
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'components', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'component_key', component_key,
        'workflow_id', workflow_id,
        'display_name', display_name,
        'operational_status', operational_status,
        'circuit_state', circuit_state,
        'consecutive_failures', consecutive_failures,
        'failures_1h', failures_1h,
        'failures_24h', failures_24h,
        'open_dead_letters', open_dead_letters,
        'last_success_at', last_success_at,
        'last_failure_at', last_failure_at
      )
      ORDER BY component_key
    )
    FROM observability.component_status
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'alerts', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'component_key', component_key,
        'severity', severity,
        'alert_type', alert_type,
        'summary', summary,
        'first_observed_at', first_observed_at
      )
      ORDER BY first_observed_at DESC NULLS LAST
    )
    FROM (
      SELECT component_key, severity, alert_type, summary, first_observed_at
      FROM observability.alert_ready
      ORDER BY first_observed_at DESC NULLS LAST
      LIMIT 10
    ) a
  ), '[]'::jsonb)
) AS control_snapshot;
